data_source.label: Data Source
data_source.description: Where chart data comes from. Manual uses the dataset children below; URL options fetch and parse a remote file.

sheets_url.label: Google Sheets URL
sheets_url.description: In Google Sheets: File → Share → Publish to web → Publish, then paste the URL here. Standard edit/share URLs also work if the sheet is set to "Anyone with the link → Viewer".

csv_source_url.label: CSV URL
csv_source_url.description: Public URL of a CSV file. First row is the header (label column + dataset names).

json_source_url.label: JSON URL
json_source_url.description: Public URL returning JSON in one of two shapes. Shape A: {"labels":["Jan","Feb"],"datasets":[{"name":"Sales","values":[10,20]}]}. Shape B: array of row objects, first key in each row becomes the label column — [{"Month":"Jan","Sales":10,"Returns":2}, {"Month":"Feb","Sales":20,"Returns":3}].

cache_ttl.label: Cache Duration
cache_ttl.description: How long the fetched data is cached on the server before refetching.

chart_title.label: Chart Title
chart_title.description: Optional title displayed above the chart.

title_position.label: Title Position
title_position.description: Position of the title relative to the chart area.

show_legend.label: Show Legend
show_legend.description: Display the legend showing dataset names and colors.

legend_position.label: Legend Position
legend_position.description: Position of the legend relative to the chart area.

legend_align.label: Legend Alignment
legend_align.description: Horizontal alignment of the legend text within its position.

show_tooltip.label: Show Tooltip
show_tooltip.description: Display a tooltip with values when hovering over a data point.

show_x_axis.label: Show X-Axis
show_x_axis.description: Display the X-axis line and tick labels.

x_axis_title.label: X-Axis Title
x_axis_title.description: Label text displayed below the X-axis.

show_x_grid.label: Show X Grid Lines
show_x_grid.description: Display vertical grid lines on the chart.

show_y_axis.label: Show Y-Axis
show_y_axis.description: Display the Y-axis line and tick labels.

y_axis_title.label: Y-Axis Title
y_axis_title.description: Label text displayed beside the Y-axis.

show_y_grid.label: Show Y Grid Lines
show_y_grid.description: Display horizontal grid lines on the chart.

y_begin_at_zero.label: Begin at Zero
y_begin_at_zero.description: Force the Y-axis to start at zero instead of auto-scaling.

y_min.label: Y-Axis Min
y_min.description: Minimum value for Y-axis. Leave empty for auto.

y_max.label: Y-Axis Max
y_max.description: Maximum value for Y-axis. Leave empty for auto.

y_step_size.label: Y-Axis Step Size
y_step_size.description: Step size between ticks. Leave empty for auto.

grid_color.label: Grid Color
grid_color.description: Color of the X and Y grid lines.

grid_width.label: Grid Line Width
grid_width.description: Thickness of the X and Y grid lines in pixels.

chart_height.label: Chart Height
chart_height.description: Height of the chart area in pixels.

enable_animation.label: Enable Animation
enable_animation.description: Animate lines when the chart first renders.

animation_duration.label: Animation Duration (ms)
animation_duration.description: How long the line animation takes in milliseconds.

animation_easing.label: Animation Easing
animation_easing.description: The easing curve for the line animation.

animate_on_scroll.label: Animate on Scroll
animate_on_scroll.description: Trigger animation only when the chart scrolls into view.
